doc.title: Monthly Updates [August]
doc.html:
INFO These update threads only contain major updates. If you're interested in seeing all minor changes you can follow our Commits Page on GitHub or Updates Channel in Discord.

Wiki Updates

  • Did a complete Contribution Guide rewrite. It's now more intuitive and fully up-to-date. TY to Hugo.

  • Added Server / Selfhosting section to Linux.

  • Added Exams / Tests section to Educational Tools. This also helped debloat the study section a bit.

  • Added Classic / Public Domain + Film Archive sections to Specialty Streaming.

  • Added Hacker News Tools section to News Sites.

  • Added Sign Language section to Language Learning.

  • Added Assistance / Charity section to Free Stuff.

  • Added Vehicle section to Miscellaneous.

  • Moved Coding Tutorials out of storage, reformatted, added labels and removed some sites. Before vs. After

  • Moved Android Telegram Clients out of storage, cleaned it up, added labels. Before vs. After

  • Moved Media Covers / Posters out of storage + added labels. Before vs. After

  • Moved Album Artwork out of storage + added labels.

  • Moved Static Page Hosting out of storage + reorganized and added labels. Before vs. After

  • Cleaned up Link in Bio section, removed sites that didn't stand out + starred Carrd. Before vs. After

  • Cleaned up Ebook section, added / fixed labels, moved sites that didn't fit the section. Before vs. After

  • Cleaned up Spotify Tools + Spotify Playlist Tools. Re-organized + removed sites that didn't stand out.

  • Cleaned up formatting in Adblock section. Before vs. After

  • Decided to bring back our Saidit backup. Saidit has always supported us; their owner actually posted FMHY themselves on the main Saidit wiki. It's always good to have places like this that we know we can trust.

  • To make streaming easier to navigate, we've separated API Frontends and Single Server sites into their own sections.

  • Thank you to Hugo, Samidy, Dan, kick, Anarchydr, and everyone else who helped re-organize or create the sections this month.

Stars Added ⭐

  • Starred Google Assistant in Song Identification. Works by humming songs; seems to be even more accurate than Shazam in our testing.

  • Starred Qwen in Image Gen. Unlimited, no signup required; seems to be almost as good as 4o as of now.

  • Starred Redlib in Reddit Tools. Privacy-friendly Reddit frontend, works without an account.

  • Starred keybr in Typing Lessons. Custom touch typing practice, has nice UI, multiplayer, profiles, themes, etc.

  • Starred Seal in Android YouTube Downloaders. Open-source downloader that supports many sites.

  • Starred SaverTuner in Android Battery Tools. Battery saving app that many people have had good results with in our testing.

  • Starred Xtra in Android Social Media. Open-source Twitch client that seems to work well for people.

  • Starred FSTV in Live Sports. Has fast streams + covers a solid amount of leagues.

  • Starred MusicBrainz Picard in Audio Metadata. Big catalog, good for batch metadata automation and sorting.

  • Starred Beanconqueror in Drinks section. Open-source, ad-free, and feature-rich brew tracking app.

  • Starred Crosshare in Crossword section. Feature-rich, custom UI, active userbase and new puzzles daily.

  • Starred CS50 in Computer Science. Well-respected Harvard Computer Science Course.

Things Removed

  • Removed nsw2u, nswdl, ps4pkg, and game-2u as they've been targeted and shut down by the FBI.

  • Removed InstallGentoo Wiki as it's been taken over by trolls. As of now the site should be avoided (NSFL content), but we'll consider re-adding if the situation ever gets handled.

  • Removed HuggingChat as it's shut down. Note that HuggingFace still works; it's only chat that's gone.

  • Removed Cobalt from YT downloaders as it no longer supports YouTube. Note that it still supports other video sites, so we've kept it in other sections it fits in.

  • Removed Masquerade Repacks as they've called it quits; note that Kaos itself is still going strong.
